state_interface.sub_lsb_boundary_rule: comparison is exact in the encoded domain; below/equal/above RTL vectors use threshold_code-1, threshold_code, threshold_code+1

min_key_occupancy.source_definition: minimum over candidate-path links of key_count / 16

bottleneck_fidelity.source_definition: minimum current fidelity over candidate-path links

offered_request_load.source_definition: requests offered in the control window divided by 4

utilization_imbalance.source_definition: clipped max-minus-min of consumed_in_last_16_steps / max(key_count, 1) over candidate-path links

policy_rom.file_format: one uppercase hexadecimal digit per state-major line
policy_rom.tie_handling: not applicable to deployed policy-index ROM; frozen training argmax used the lowest action index

profile_rom.file_format: five uppercase hexadecimal digits per action-major line

dwell.first_valid_decision: accept proposed action immediately and set dwell_count to 1
dwell.same_action: retain action and increment dwell_count with saturation at 3
dwell.early_change: retain current action and increment dwell_count with saturation at 3
dwell.eligible_change: when proposed action differs and dwell_count is at least 3, accept it and set dwell_count to 1
dwell.equivalence_boundary: saturating the unobservable count at 3 is action-timeline equivalent to the unbounded frozen Python count

module_timing.reset: synchronous active-high; reset dominates start and all enables
module_timing.rl_state_encoder: enable sampled on edge N; valid and state_id asserted for one cycle after edge N+1
module_timing.rl_policy_rom: enable and state_id sampled on edge N; valid and proposed_action asserted for one cycle after edge N+1
module_timing.rl_profile_rom: enable and selected_action sampled on edge N; valid and profile_payload asserted for one cycle after edge N+1
module_timing.rl_controller_valid_request: request accepted on edge N when start and ready; done/output_valid asserted after edge N+3
module_timing.rl_controller_invalid_request: start with ready and input_valid low is rejected; done and invalid_state asserted after edge N+1
module_timing.output_valid: one-cycle pulse coincident with done only for a valid completed decision
module_timing.busy: high from valid request acceptance through the cycle before done
module_timing.stall: one-cycle status pulse whenever start is asserted while ready is low; active transaction is unchanged

exception_behavior.encoded_numeric_clipping: UNORM16 ports inherently represent the clipped domain 0..1 inclusive
exception_behavior.input_valid_low: no encoder, ROM, dwell, selected-action, or profile state update
exception_behavior.no_path: sampled with an accepted valid request and reported with done; it does not suppress policy selection or dwell advancement
exception_behavior.start_while_busy: not accepted and does not modify the in-flight request
